changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_auth.users ( id, version, first_name, last_name, user_name, password, email, email_verified, phone_code, contact_number, phone_number_verified, account_non_expired, account_non_locked, account_locked, credentials_non_expired, active_ind, created_by, created_date ) VALUES ( nextval('user_auth.users_seq'), 0, 'System', 'Admin', 'sysadmin', crypt('Admin@1234', gen_salt('bf', 12)), 'admin@shopwire.internal', true, '+91', '9000000001', true, true, true, false, true, true, 'system', now() ), ( nextval('user_auth.users_seq'), 0, 'System', 'User', 'sysuser', crypt('User@1234', gen_salt('bf', 12)), 'user@shopwire.internal', true, '+91', '9000000002', true, true, true, false, true, true, 'system', now() );
INSERT INTO user_auth.user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.id, r.id FROM user_auth.users u, user_auth.role r WHERE u.user_name = 'sysadmin' AND r.role_name = 'ROLE_ADMIN';
INSERT INTO user_auth.user_role (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.id, r.id FROM user_auth.users u, user_auth.role r WHERE u.user_name = 'sysuser' AND r.role_name = 'ROLE_USER';
